label: Analysis methods
description: The analysis step: every analytical technique the paper used and each instrument setting it states, in analysis_<technique>_<setting> columns named from a vocabulary of techniques (analysis_vocab.json).
covers: every analytical technique the paper used and each instrument setting it states (HPLC/GC columns, mobile phases, detection wavelengths, MS/MALDI/NMR settings, standards, detection limits) -- so no parameters or stages for analysis details; one text column naming the analysis method is fine.

variable_categories.label: Analysis
variable_categories.description: how the products were analysed: technique, instrument and its settings

analysis.runs: not analytical techniques or instrument settings (column, mobile phase, wavelength, matrix, laser, voltages, standards, detection limits): a separate step records them
analysis.off: analysis details beyond the analysis method DO belong here (instrument, column, mobile phase, detection wavelength, standards, detection limit): one entry each
